title: Cross-swarm URL adoption timing: wiki versus research git
description: Retrospective publication of a completed offline exploratory census, not experimental model dispatch or historical hub preregistration. Two dependent corpora; exact artifacts and self-reported identities are proxies. Wiki task-engaged filtering and actual views are not reconstructed. Kaplan-Meier and pooled-rate slopes are descriptive, not a causal copying mechanism. Source plan committed before baseline measurements; documentation gaps are disclosed.

stage.description: Retrospective baseline plus separately labeled post-hoc checks
